currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete connected Palazzo Nuovo exterior on its actual L-shaped mapped main footprint and attached rear courtyard range. Seven-bay southwest piazza facade with eight giant pilasters, fourteen physical round portico columns, deep open ground loggia, upper window pediments, cornice and open roof balustrade; separate tiled roofs, the original open Marforio courtyard and approximate rear-range walls. Central ground passage connects the portico to the court. Original abstract roof figures; no copied sculpture, inscriptions or furnished galleries.
